# Dubai Interior (Onepass Interior)

> Dubai's trust-first renovation marketplace at onepassinterior.com. We list 649 licensed interior fit-out contractors across 23 Dubai areas, publish quantitative performance data instead of star ratings, and connect homeowners with vetted contractors through free quotes and consultations.

Key facts:
- Directory: 649 licensed Dubai interior/fit-out companies with Google ratings, verification badges (licence, contact, portfolio), and area/specialty filters.
- Quotes: homeowners submit one brief and receive up to 5 quotes from licensed contractors, free. Contact details are never sold or shown publicly.
- Consultation: free AI-assisted intake turns a plain-language description into a structured renovation brief; the concierge team follows up on WhatsApp.
- Open Projects board: anonymised renovation briefs contractors can quote on.
- Consumer protection: standard contract terms (staged payments, written variation orders, delay clause, 5-10% retention, 12-month warranty), platform mediation, and escalation support to Dubai Consumer (DET, 600 545 555). Aligned with Dubai Law No. 7 of 2025 on contracting activities.

## Main pages
- [Find Contractors](https://onepassinterior.com/companies): browse and filter all 649 licensed companies
- [Request Quotes](https://onepassinterior.com/quote): one brief, up to 5 quotes, free
- [Free Consultation](https://onepassinterior.com/consult): describe your project in your own words
- [Open Projects](https://onepassinterior.com/requests): live renovation briefs open for contractor quotes
- [How You're Protected](https://onepassinterior.com/protection): contracts, mediation, official escalation channels
- [Guides](https://onepassinterior.com/guides): renovation costs, permits, contractor vetting, complaints and consumer rights in Dubai
